data.long_meaning: Aalee (علي) is the Arabic ʿalī, 'high, exalted, sublime', from the root ʿ-l-w. It is a very common name and is borne by ʿAlī ibn Abī Ṭālib, the fourth caliph and a central figure in Islamic history.

faq.q: What does the name Aalee mean?

faq.a: Aalee is used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian, Pashto.

faq.q: Is Aalee a boy's name or a girl's name?
faq.a: Aalee is used as a male name.

faq.q: How is Aalee written in Arabic and Urdu?
faq.a: Aalee is written علي in Arabic and علی in Urdu, and अली in Devanagari.

faq.q: What is the linguistic root of Aalee?
faq.a: The root of Aalee is ع-ل-و (ʿ-l-w).

faq.q: What is the etymology of Aalee?
faq.a: Arabic ʿalī, 'high, exalted', from the root ʿ-l-w.

faq.q: Does Aalee appear in the Qur'an?
faq.a: Not a Qur'anic personal name; ʿalī, 'high', is Arabic vocabulary from the root ʿ-l-w.

faq.q: Who was ʿAlī ibn Abī Ṭālib?
faq.a: ʿAlī ibn Abī Ṭālib was the cousin and son-in-law of the Prophet Muhammad and the fourth of the Rightly Guided Caliphs.

faq.q: What is the numerology or lucky number of Aalee?

faq.q: What are the common spelling variants of Aalee?
faq.a: Aalee appears with variants and alternative spellings such as Ali, Aali.

faq.q: Which names are related to Aalee?
faq.a: Names sharing form or root with Aalee include Aali, Aaliyah.
